one_liner: SEO and SERP data provider offering REST APIs for search, keyword, backlink, on-page, and business data.

auth.evidence_quote: DataForSEO is using the Basic Authentication, which makes it possible to call our APIs with almost any programming language
auth.notes: Credentials are a login/password pair base64-encoded into the Authorization header, not a single vendor-labeled 'API key'.

access.notes: Docs reference a free unlimited trial, an API Playground, and a sandbox; full pricing tiers not directly fetched.

api.notes: Endpoints span SERP, AI Optimization, Keywords Data, Domain Analytics, Backlinks, OnPage, Merchant, App Data, and Business Data APIs -- well over 100 total endpoints across categories. MCP details from search results, not directly fetched, so quote omitted.

verdict.rationale: Free trial/sandbox access, Basic Auth documented, broad REST API surface, and an official MCP server all point to immediate buildability.
